title: Acquire and validate the first NASA POWER evidence sample

acceptance.how: Agree one supported pilot, exact POWER rainfall/temperature parameters, suitable historical period and story/replay needs; no additional mission required.
acceptance.verification: Selection and limitations are documented; 2001–2025 is conditional on coverage.

acceptance.how: Implement bounded timeout/error handling and a reproducible acquisition command.
acceptance.verification: Raw bytes are authentic; no credential is committed.

acceptance.how: Check fill codes, time standard, expected/leap-day counts and native/output grid scale.
acceptance.verification: QA tests and an actual quality report identify gaps without silently filling them.

acceptance.how: Write a versioned normalized table plus checksum/source/license/processing metadata.
acceptance.verification: Another teammate can reproduce the exact normalized bytes.

acceptance.how: Use deterministic daily/monthly/seasonal methods with documented missingness.
acceptance.verification: Reference cases verify units, sums/means and missing-day behavior.

acceptance.how: Commit only a small redistribution-permitted subset with source manifest.
acceptance.verification: Fixture bytes/source/checksum and replay commands are reviewable.

acceptance.how: Fardin reproduces outputs; Maruf checks agricultural applicability.
acceptance.verification: Reviewed/merged evidence and schema version are recorded for G2/G3.

acceptance.text: Prepare versioned chart and replay payloads
acceptance.how: Predeclare comparison periods/stress selection; export real arrays, units, sample counts, missingness and method/source identities.
acceptance.verification: Charts/replay refer to the same verified evidence; no trend or forecast is invented.

history.note: Rebased planned work to the mandatory-now/future specifications. No product feature, review or delivery is marked complete.

next_action: Review G0 contracts now; acquire the first evidence slice after G0 is accepted.
handoff: Fardin consumes evidence in G2; Prachurjo consumes approved chart arrays in G3; Maruf reviews applicability.
purpose: Provide authentic reproducible NASA climate context rather than illustrative frontend values.
